name: Valley of Bones
summary: In Shen'dralas, the Valley of Bones lies choked with dust and ancient remains. Restless dead haunt its canyon, where centaur necromancers patrol among the colossal ribs of two Dead Goliaths.

sections.title: A Canyon of the Restless Dead
sections.body: Skeletal horrors walk the dusty ravines of the Valley of Bones, a canyon in the south. Centaur necromancers raise them with dark sorcery and command them. The spirits of the Magram centaur clan wander there too, bound to the barren earth long after their violent deaths. Two immense skeletons, called the Dead Goliaths, slump against the rocky cliffs. Scholars and travelers do not know where they came from.

faq.answer: The Dead Goliaths are the colossal remains of two unknown creatures against the canyon walls. Little is known of their kind or when they died, though their great size suggests beasts from a forgotten era.

faq.q: Why are there centaur ghosts here?
faq.answer: The ghosts belong to the Magram, a violent centaur clan native to these arid plains. Unending war between centaur clans and the necromancers' meddling with the dead have denied the Magram spirits rest. They wander the canyon as apparitions.

faq.q: Who controls the skeletons in the valley?
faq.answer: Centaur necromancers practice dark rites in the canyon. They raise skeletal servants and command them to guard the crags and hold their ground among the dead.

angles.text: As a priest, you witness the valley's desecration of spirits. Dark practitioners bind Magram souls and raise twisted skeletal servants, perverting death's natural passage.
